goal: Collect the highest-value runtime/accessibility evidence when Opera Browser Connector returns, without accumulating tabs or exhausting memory.

browser_memory_policy.pair: one source tab + one target tab for the active page only
browser_memory_policy.reuse: navigate the same two tab IDs to the next page rather than opening new diagnostic tabs
browser_memory_policy.cleanup: close view-source/wp-login/old qa query tabs before starting; after each page, retain only the pair or navigate them onward
browser_memory_policy.no_full_dom_spam: prefer targeted tab-content jq/search queries over repeated full accessibility-tree pagination
browser_memory_policy.screenshots: use only when connector screenshot becomes available; otherwise do not retry screenshot repeatedly in the same package
browser_memory_policy.animations: sample only documented states/times; do not leave autoplay pages open across unrelated tests

visual_capture_contract: same browser engine, DPR, zoom, load state and scroll position for source/target pair
wait for fonts/images before static capture
animations use matched start and documented time/scroll progress; do not compare random autoplay frames
capture source, target, overlay/diff and key geometry; image resizing must not mask page-height/content differences

stop_conditions: connector becomes unstable/disconnected: stop opening/retrying tabs and persist partial evidence
memory pressure/tab proliferation: close stale tabs before continuing

no screenshot action: keep PIXEL_PASS=false; interaction/AX evidence does not substitute for pixel acceptance
